description: This is a Java JUnit test class that performs automated web UI testing using Selenium WebDriver for the 'Estabelecimento' entity in the 'agiletickets' application. It tests adding establishments, validating input errors, and verifying display of parking information.

classes.name: EstabelecimentoTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for automating web tests related to 'Estabelecimento' management in the application using Selenium WebDriver.

methods.name: abreBrowser
methods.description: Initializes the WebDriver with a FirefoxDriver instance before all tests run.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment before each test by instantiating the EstabelecimentosDriver with the web driver.

methods.name: teardown
methods.description: Closes the WebDriver after all tests are executed.

methods.name: aoAdicionarUmEstabelecimentoDeveMostraLoNaTabela
methods.description: Tests adding a new establishment and verifies it appears in the management table.

methods.name: aoAdicionarUmEstabelecimentoSemNomeDeveMostrarErro
methods.description: Tests validation when adding an establishment without a name, expecting an error message.

methods.name: aoAdicionarUmEstabelecimentoSemEnderecoDeveMostrarErro
methods.description: Tests validation when adding an establishment without an address, expecting an error message.

methods.name: mostraQueHaEstacionamentoQuandoCadastramosQueSim
methods.description: Verifies that parking is indicated when an establishment with parking is registered.

methods.name: mostraQueNaoHaEstacionamentoQuandoCadastramosQueNao
methods.description: Verifies that parking is not indicated when an establishment without parking is registered.
